precedence: this amendment overrides only the interpretation of the Native-6 v3 development gate
reason: RACER development and a preregistered read-only diagnostic showed that assigned-to-eligible measures whether the native policy reaches a physical event, whereas eligible-to-injected and injected-to-effect measure whether the fault adapter acts correctly once that event exists
unchanged: fault families, severities, eligibility definitions, interventions, and physical-effect definitions
simulator clock and first-eligible-event trigger rule
episode result schema and seven result identity fields

eligible_event_evidence.purpose: ensure every adapter path has at least one observed physical opportunity in development

prohibited: changing the threshold only for RACER or one task-fault cell
relabeling diagnostic replays as development results
replacing the three original non-eligible RACER episodes
selective reruns or resampling to raise assigned-to-eligible
using formal outcomes to revise the gate
dropping untriggered assigned episodes from intention-to-treat results
prospective_status: frozen before any Native-6 v3 formal perturbed episode is run
